name: Bemethyl

protocolDosing.notes: up to 750–1000 mg/day in some protocols; accumulates with repeated doses — course-based dosing with breaks manages this; human t½ not published; Russian pharmaceutical standard (Metaprot)

effects: increased physical/cognitive performance under hypoxic conditions (actoprotection)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Actoprotector/antihypoxant; activates genomic pathways increasing RNA synthesis and gluconeogenic enzyme induction.
mechanismOfAction.description: Benzimidazole actoprotector; activates PEPCK and G6Pase (gluconeogenic enzymes) via RNA synthesis induction; increases mitochondrial ATP production; antioxidant (reduces lipid peroxidation); antihypoxant (improves cellular oxygen utilization efficiency). BBB-penetrant. Accumulates with repeated doses — mechanism distinct from classical monoaminergic stimulants. Russian/CIS registered pharmaceutical (Metaprot); not FDA/EMA approved.
